description: The headless masked input core of the SvGrid UI kit in Svelte 5. SvMaskedInput is a styled renderer over createMaskedInput, the pattern-mask engine where # is a digit, A a letter and * alphanumeric, exposed as inputProps. One core drives the styled field and a custom boxed field with a complete or partial badge, both bound to one value.

faq.question: What does the core expose besides inputProps?
faq.answer: The masked text, the raw characters and a complete flag, which the custom render uses for its badge; the styled field uses the same values for its clear button and validation.

faq.question: What happens to characters that do not fit?
faq.answer: The engine ignores any character that does not match the next slot and skips over literal characters automatically, so typing digits into a card mask lands them in the right places in any render.

faq.question: Can the same engine be used outside an input?
faq.answer: Yes. The mask engine is a pure function used by the phone and date-time pickers as well, so formatting a value for display needs no input element.
